company_description: Marathon Petroleum Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as an integrated downstream energy company in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Refining & Marketing; Midstream; and Renewable Diesel. The Refining & Marketing segment refines crude oil and other feedstocks at its refineries in the Gulf Coast, Mid-Continent, and West Coast regions of the United States; and purchases refined products and ethanol for resale and distributes refined products through transportation, storage, distribution, and marketing services. Its refined products include transportation fuels, such as reformulated gasolines and blend-grade gasolines; heavy fuel oil; and asphalt. This segment also manufactures propane and petrochemicals. The company sells refined products to wholesale marketing customers in the United States and internationally, buyers on the spot market, and independent entrepreneurs who operate primarily Marathon branded outlets, as well as through long-term fuel supply contracts to direct dealer locations primarily under the ARCO brand. risks.title: Critical Accounting Estimates and Imprecisions
risks.summary: MPC must estimate the fair value of its assets (refining, pipelines, investments) using assumptions about future cash flows, discount rates, and volumes. Actual results may differ significantly from these projections, impacting financial statements and results.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned early in Item 1A section (strong position). Moderate intensity language ('could differ materially'). Stable trend, recurring each year. Capital category weighted heavily as it directly affects financial statements and asset valuations.

risks.title: Asset Impairment and $9.35B Goodwill
risks.summary: MPC holds $9.35 billion in goodwill allocated across 5 reporting units. If market conditions deteriorate (price declines, reduced volumes, compressed margins), these assets could be impaired, generating significant accounting losses.
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed mid-section with concrete figures ($9.35B goodwill). Moderate language ('may not be recoverable'). Stable trend but substantial amount. Capital category critical as it represents 15-20% of typical assets for an integrated oil major.

risks.title: Commodity Price Volatility
risks.summary: MPC is exposed to fluctuations in crude oil, refined products, natural gas, and natural gas liquids prices. Although the company uses derivatives for hedging, a prolonged price decline would reduce refining margins and midstream revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Risk disclosed at end of Item 7A section with explicit language ('exposed to market risks'). Moderate intensity ('could materially affect'). Stable but structural trend for the sector. Macro category weighted heavily for an integrated oil company.

risks.title: Future Volume Assumptions and Customer Demand
risks.summary: Estimates of future refining, pipeline transportation, and natural gas processing volumes rely on subjective internal forecasts. These assumptions depend on variable factors such as future oil and gas prices, which are difficult to predict accurately.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified mid-section with uncertainty language ('inherently subjective and contingent'). Stable trend but acknowledged as difficult to forecast. Industrial category as it directly affects refining and midstream operations.

risks.title: Equity Method Investments ($6.80B)
risks.summary: MPC holds $6.80 billion in equity method investments in associated companies. If these investments lose value or no longer generate sufficient income, MPC will need to record an impairment.
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified mid-section with specific amount ($6.80B). Moderate language ('other than temporary loss'). Stable trend. Capital category as it represents approximately 10% of assets and depends on the performance of non-controlled entities.

risks.title: Discount Rate Risk and Pension Obligations
risks.summary: MPC's pension and post-retirement benefit obligations are highly sensitive to discount rates. A 0.25% decrease in rates would increase obligations by $75 million and annual expense by $11 million.
risks.score_rationale: Risk detailed with quantified sensitivities (0.25% decrease = +$75M in obligations). Technical language but material impact. Stable trend but sensitive to interest rates. Capital category as it affects the balance sheet and pension charges.

risks.title: Acquisition Uncertainties and Fair Value
risks.summary: During acquisitions, MPC estimates the fair value of assets, liabilities, and contingent consideration using complex approaches (income, cost, market). These estimates rely on uncertain assumptions and actual results may differ significantly.
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned mid-section with uncertainty language ('inherently uncertain', 'may differ materially'). Stable but recurring trend. Capital category as it affects post-acquisition valuations and goodwill.
